notes.title: Neko Patch 1.0
notes.content:
[p][b] Localization Fixes[/b]
We've addressed issues with character display for certain languages. Text should now render correctly across all supported languages.[/p][p] [b]Achievements[/b]
Achievements are finally here![/p][p] [b]Audio Improvements[/b]
We’ve fine-tuned the volume and sound design in specific parts of the game to ensure a more balanced and immersive experience.[/p][p]Thank you for your support and feedback — it really helps us make the game better.
Enjoy the game and have fun![/p]
